resultJson.title: Add file manipulation sample script
resultJson.body:
Adds `file_manipulation.py`, a small sample showing basic file operations with `pathlib` and `shutil`: write, append, read, copy, rename, list and delete. It runs inside a temporary directory, so nothing is left on disk.

The diff also includes an `.orca/runs/*.progress.json` run-log file, which is not part of the sample.
